name: notion-mcp-server
description: Read and write Notion with a token: search pages, query databases with typed filters, read and write pages as markdown, and batch edits. Runs the open-source notion-mcp-server locally; not made by Notion.

interface.shortDescription: Search, query and edit Notion with a token.
defaultPrompt: Find my "Tasks" database in Notion and list everything due this week that isn't done.
